seed_bank.rule: planning uses preallocated last five entries; final uses first R entries with R<=4091; never redraw after outcomes

primary_estimand: E_time[mean_frozen_seed squared_error]; finite R trained-model panel
alternative_justification: 3% minimum design alternative exceeds retained 2% practical RMSE margin by 1 percentage point; 5% sensitivity. No guarantee for effects arbitrarily close to 2%.
temporal_settings_status: EXACT_R10_T768_B8191_ALPHA025_CONDITIONALLY_ADMITTED; other sizes/tuning require their own evidence

budget.checkpoint_storage_assumption: 64MiB per selected+latest bundled model/optimizer/RNG state per fit, planning assumption only; replace with receipt measurements prospectively
budget.power_mc_budget_basis: Reviewable ceiling fixed before any real planning-power run: 1024 selection plus 2048 validation analyzer calls for this single-cell grid; 3600s wall budget includes both stages. This is an authorization ceiling informed by the synthetic implementation benchmark, not measured market runtime or achieved power.

calendar_coupling: shared actual-date blocks within coincident groups; independent calendar draws across disjoint groups as a conditional empirical-DGP assumption, never inferred shared shocks by relative origin index
other_development_settings_policy: Any other R/T/B, HAC/block, reference or operational alpha requires its own explicit matching admission; no extrapolation of the single-panel V4 family calibration to joint cross-panel error control.
power_rule_correction: Prospective pre-market correction: estimate exactly the finite-B count+1/Holm rule used by final assessment. CP upper-tail uncertainty and stricter re-Holm sensitivity are recorded, never substituted into the operational rule. Outer MC includes inner bootstrap randomization; simultaneous CP power lower bounds remain the >=.90 gate.

data_design_amendment.scope: metadata-only adapter/source labels; the numerical and scientific settings are byte-identical after stripping the four metadata fields
data_design_amendment.selection_basis: Contract economic domain and prespecified development sample size; no new model outcomes used
